sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY/CNTRL GULF COAST STATES/TX GULF COAST
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER WEST TX. THIS FEATURE WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS TODAY. AHEAD OF THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH...A LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD EXIST FROM THE SABINE RIVER VALLEY NNEWD INTO THE OZARKS AT 12Z WITH AN MCS ONGOING ON THE NRN END OF THE JET OVER ERN AR AND NR MS. ANOTHER CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS FORECAST TO INITIATE IN EAST TX THIS MORNING WITH CONVECTIVE COVERAGE INCREASING EWD INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY BY MIDDAY. THE LATEST MODELS SUGGEST A SQUALL-LINE WILL FORM THIS AFTERNOON FROM NW AL SWWD ACROSS NRN AND CNTRL MS INTO CNTRL AND SRN LA. STRONG LOW-LEVEL FLOW AND SOMEWHAT UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES EVIDENT ON FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE AS THE SQUALL-LINE MOVES EWD ACROSS CNTRL LA...CNTRL MS INTO WCNTRL AL AROUND MID-AFTERNOON SUNDAY. A FEW TORNADOES AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH BOWING SEGMENTS AND SUPERCELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE. THE GREATEST HAIL THREAT SHOULD EXIST ACROSS THE SWRN PART OF THE LINE LATE SUNDAY AFTERNOON ACROSS SW MS...CNTRL LA AND SE TX WHERE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE STEEPER AND THE STORMS MAY HAVE A TENDENCY TO BE MORE DISCRETE. sections.title: NRN NC/SRN VA
sections.text: AT THE SFC...A LOW WILL MOVE QUICKLY EWD ACROSS TN VALLEY INTO THE SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS SUNDAY AS A FRONTAL BOUNDARY MOVES SLOWLY NWD ACROSS NRN NC INTO SRN VA BY MID-AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG THE BOUNDARY IN THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF NRN NC AND MOVE EWD ACROSS THE COASTAL PLAINS DURING THE MID TO LATE AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALONG THIS CORRIDOR AT 21Z SUNDAY SHOW MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 40 TO 50 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ESPECIALLY NEAR PEAK HEATING WHEN INSTABILITY WILL BE MAXIMIZED. THE MOST FAVORABLE SEVERE THREAT MAY BE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS DUE TO UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES AND STRONG LOW-LEVEL FLOW. IF ENOUGH INSTABILITY CAN MATERIALIZE...THEN A CLUSTER OF STORMS WITH HAIL POTENTIAL WOULD ALSO BE POSSIBLE.

sections.text: ...ERN TX/LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY INTO THE SRN APPALACHIANS... WELL DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER TX WILL CONTINUE EJECTING ENEWD ACROSS THE LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY/MID SOUTH TODAY. AT THE SURFACE...COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/FRONT FROM THE LOWER TN RIVER VALLEY INTO CENTRAL LA AT 12Z WILL LIKELY REMAIN STALLED OR SAG SLOWLY SSEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S F WILL PERSIST AHEAD OF THE FRONT AND SUPPORT MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR WITH AFTERNOON HEATING. THIS WILL ALSO ALL BUT ELIMINATE CAPPING BY THE EARLY TO MID AFTERNOON NEAR THE FRONT. ONGOING CLUSTERS OF ELEVATED STORMS MAY CONTINUE THROUGH THE MORNING FROM NRN LA INTO NRN/CENTRAL MS. SMALL LEADING LINE OF STORMS OVER CENTRAL MS THIS MORNING MAY CONTINUE TO BE FED BY RESERVOIR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IN PLACE ACROSS WARM SECTOR. ISOLATED SEVERE MAY ACCOMPANY THIS CLUSTER OF STORMS INTO WRN AL THIS MORNING.
